sources.title: Kestrel - Junjie Fei / Research Assistant
sources.snippet: We report the performance of Kestrel on grounded description generation, direct segmentation, and reasoning-based segmentation across our proposed 3DCoMPaT-GrIn dataset as well as other public benchmarks. To further demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our model, we also evaluate Kestrel in out-of-domain and real-world scenarios.
